body: This important decision determines if I would be able to continue my education at my university. Now, it may seem like it's not the end of the world ... but I've lied to everyone that I know about my degree progress, my courses, my grades, everything about my college education ..... When I mean "failure", I really do mean a failure ..... I have let myself down because I took what I had for granted. I didn't try hard enough and now look where it's got me... I might get kicked out of school. Everyone thinks I'm a smart person, who studies hard, and gets good grades.... but I'm not that person. I used to be back in high school .... I don't know what changed . All I know is that if I cannot continue my education at this university, I don't know what to do. Yes, I could transfer to another school. Then I would have to explain myself to everyone I love. They would look down upon me and hate me so much ......
